svg.title: fit action flow
svg.desc: Prepare exact inference and retain exact-model joint draws. Interrupted remote fits fail once; bounded chunks preserve the complete result.

g.text: target: new(model + data) or continue(fit revision)
repeat enters call identity; reasoning is optional/excluded
or no valid input for latest
messages: log, progress, traces and failure
GET reads it without execution or retry
read-only facade has no saved call
status: running · commit_id: null · body: null
messages: accumulated log, progress and traces
missing indicator ID or changed dtype,
no rows or anchor times for the model
codes or values outside likelihood support
priors that cannot compile for fitting
unsupported diffusion or dSMC replay stage
exact readings conflict with declared laws
input trajectory without a starting value
a location prior 6+ SDs from the data
new: prior-only trace + chart; Gaussian starts
continue: restore state/RNG; refresh joint potential + gradient
zero warmup freezes tuning; changed chart/algorithm rewarms
fit owns compilation, binding and sampler admission
JAX executable cache; runtime numerical and reporting controls
nuts_da: NUTS or fixed HMC; own warmup
MPGibbs: parameter ensemble → path update → companions
shared movement adaptation; tree or filter weight diagnostics
tempering: cold draws; segment diagnostics + gate before combining
compile to fit memory; cache Modal result by content hash
local / Modal connection, image or cache error
interrupted fit fails once; repeat is explicit
8 MiB Zstd chunks; verify full return
corrupt / incomplete output: no scientific results
decoded parameters and free states: R-hat < 1.05
bulk and tail ESS ≥ 100 per chain; frozen chains fail
failed finding → warning with its code and subject
simulate then reports no causal effect
save parameterization + mixed mask; native energies stay specific
append draws per chain + state/RNG/tuning; zero draws keep prior report
check: a failure is saved as a warning
step the checks below depend on
An error without a label fails as
retain admission; check data and question windows
opt-in frequency / regional movement; coverage + worst 10
